Clarks — E-commerce experience

E-commerce Retail UI/UX Motion

A full redesign of the Clarks e-commerce experience, modernising the storefront from browsing and product discovery through to checkout.

Delivered with the Clarks team at BBH London, spanning concept, interface design and motion.

The work landed so well that Clarks wanted to commit to building the vision in full, rather than phasing the rollout or trimming it back to fit a budget, they backed the experience as designed.
